title: Croc! Pau-Pau Island
native_title: クロック！ ～パウパウ・アイランド～
overview:
An evil shadow falls over the calm and peaceful Pau-Pau Island... Croc's adventure begins, to rescue his friends who have been taken away.

Croc is a young crocodile raised by a tribe of small, furry creatures. When an evil baron and his army invade their island, capture the whole tribe and scatter them across a chain of islands, Croc sets out to bring every one of them home.

In this 3D platformer, explore each level, open crates and cages to free the captives, and collect crystals that protect you from harm. Swipe enemies with your tail or stomp them from above, gather five colored crystals to open a hidden bonus area, then ring the gong to finish the stage.

- 1 player
- Sega Multi Controller compatible

のどかで平和なパウパウアイランドに邪悪な影が…
連れ去られた仲間を助けるためにクロックの冒険が始まる
